proposals.before: the nineteenth year of Biographies
proposals.after: Biographies 19
proposals.reason: 列傳第十九 is the serial number of the biography chapter, not a year.

proposals.before: Xie Lingyun, Commander of the Left Guard to the Heir Apparent, killed men more than once; Imperial Censor Xu Zhunzhi was removed for failing to impeach him.
proposals.after: Xie Lingyun, Commander of the Left Guard to the Heir Apparent, killed men on his own authority; Imperial Censor Wang Zhunzhi was removed for failing to impeach him.
proposals.reason: Chinese 王准之 is Wang Zhunzhi, not Xu; 輒殺人 is arbitrary/unauthorized killing, not specifically 'more than once'.

proposals.before: Nothing there is to fault;
proposals.after: It cannot be done;
proposals.reason: 不可 continues a quotation and means refusal/impossibility, not 'nothing to fault'.

proposals.before: Tan was already dead; his son Ling Sun, Grand Administrator of Shanyang, surrendered himself to the Minister of Justice.
proposals.after: Tan was already dead; his son Lingsun, Grand Administrator of Shanyang, surrendered himself to the Minister of Justice.
proposals.reason: 令孫 is a single given name, not two English words Ling and Sun.

proposals.before: An edict ordered external deliberation. Yigong had Secretariat Director Liu Yuanjing accuse Xingzong and Director Yuan Min of privately promising each other appointments, selecting each other, disordering government, and befouling great policy.
proposals.after: An edict ordered external deliberation. Yigong had Secretariat Director Liu Yuanjing accuse Xingzong and Director Yuan Minsun of privately promising each other appointments, selecting each other, disordering government, and befouling great policy.
proposals.reason: Chinese 袁湣孫 is Yuan Minsun; idiomatic English drops the final character as Yuan Min.

proposals.before: An edict ordered external detailed deliberation; Yigong had Secretariat Director Liu Yuanjing memorialize that Xingzong and Director Yuan Min had privately promised each other appointments, selecting each other and disordering the group, harming government and befouling great policy.
proposals.after: An edict ordered external detailed deliberation; Yigong had Secretariat Director Liu Yuanjing memorialize that Xingzong and Director Yuan Minsun had privately promised each other appointments, selecting each other and disordering the group, harming government and befouling great policy.
proposals.reason: Literal English also shortens 袁湣孫 to Yuan Min.

proposals.before: Before long Faxing was killed, Shangzhi imprisoned, Yigong and Shibo executed; Xingzong was restored as Senior Administrator to Prince Ziye of Linhai's Forward Army and Grand Administrator of Nan Command, acting Governor of Jing—he did not go.
proposals.after: Before long Faxing was killed, Shangzhi imprisoned, Yigong and Shibo executed; Xingzong was restored as Senior Administrator to Prince Zixu of Linhai's Forward Army and Grand Administrator of Nan Command, acting Governor of Jing—he did not go.
proposals.reason: Chinese 臨海王子頊 is Prince Zixu, not Prince Ziye.

proposals.before: Before long Faxing was killed, Shangzhi imprisoned, Yigong and Shibo all executed; Xingzong was restored as Senior Administrator to Prince Ziye of Linhai's Forward Army and Grand Administrator of Nan Command, acting as Governor of Jing Province—he did not go.
proposals.after: Before long Faxing was killed, Shangzhi imprisoned, Yigong and Shibo all executed; Xingzong was restored as Senior Administrator to Prince Zixu of Linhai's Forward Army and Grand Administrator of Nan Command, acting as Governor of Jing Province—he did not go.
proposals.reason: Literal English repeats the Zixu/Ziye mistranslation.

proposals.before: At each court feast the Emperor beat the hundred ministers with a club; from General of Agile Cavalry Prince Jian'an Xiuren downward, Palace Attendant Yuan Min and the rest all suffered abuse and dragging—only Xingzong was spared.
proposals.after: At each court feast the Emperor beat the hundred ministers with a club; from General of Agile Cavalry Prince Jian'an Xiuren downward, Palace Attendant Yuan Minsun and the rest all suffered abuse and dragging—only Xingzong was spared.
proposals.reason: Chinese 袁湣孫 is the three-character personal name Yuan Minsun; the idiomatic rendering drops 孫.

proposals.before: He was transferred to Vice Director of the Secretariat and soon also headed the Court of the Imperial Clan.
proposals.after: He was transferred to Vice Director of the Secretariat and soon also headed the Court of the Palace Guards.
proposals.reason: 衛尉 is the Chamberlain / Court of the Palace Guards, not the Court of the Imperial Clan (宗正).

proposals.before: He was transferred to Vice Director of the Secretariat and soon also headed the Court of the Imperial Clan.
proposals.after: He was transferred to Vice Director of the Secretariat and soon also concurrently headed the Guard Commandant (Weiwei).
proposals.reason: Literal English repeats the same mistranslation of 衛尉 as Imperial Clan.

proposals.before: When Zheqi was pacified, Yuan Yan's head arrived in a box; an edict ordered Xingzong to ascend the South Yeb Gate tower to view it.
proposals.after: When Zheqi was pacified, Yuan Yan's head arrived in a box; an edict ordered Xingzong to ascend the South Lateral Gate tower to view it.
proposals.reason: 南掖門 is the South Lateral (side) Gate; Yeb is a corrupted transcription.

proposals.before: When the affair was settled, Xingzong was enfeoffed as Marquis of Shichang; he declined and was refused; it was changed to Marquis of Le'an; state salary and clerical labor he ultimately did not accept.
proposals.after: When the affair was settled, Xingzong was enfeoffed as Earl of Shichang County; he declined and was refused; it was changed to Earl of Le'an County; state salary and clerical labor he ultimately did not accept.
proposals.reason: 縣伯 is a county earldom (bo), not a marquisate (hou).

proposals.before: The Secretariat drafted an edict to persuade Yan; Xingzong said: "The realm is settled; this is the day Yan would submit. Your Majesty should bestow a handwritten edition of several lines.
proposals.after: The Secretariat drafted an edict to persuade Yan; Xingzong said: "The realm is settled; this is the day Yan would submit. Your Majesty should bestow a handwritten edict of several lines.
proposals.reason: 手詔 is a handwritten edict, not an edition.

proposals.before: Zhensun's grandson Jingxian was very talented; Xingzong kept company with him.
proposals.after: Zhensun's son Jingxian was very talented; Xingzong kept company with him.
proposals.reason: 丘珍孫 is a personal name; 珍孫子景先 means Jingxian, son of Zhensun, not a grandson.

proposals.before: When Jingxian was Grand Administrator of Poyang, Prince Jin'an Ziluan rebelled; he transferred to Jingling and was killed by Wu Xi.
proposals.after: When Jingxian was Grand Administrator of Poyang, Prince Jin'an Zixun rebelled; he transferred to Jingling and was killed by Wu Xi.
proposals.reason: Chinese 子勳 is Zixun; Ziluan is a different imperial prince's name.

proposals.before: Commander of the Left Guard to the Heir Apparent Wang Xi's wife Fan was an intelligent woman with talent and learning.
proposals.after: Fan, wife of Wang Xi, Commander of the Left Guard to the Heir Apparent, was an intelligent woman with talent and learning.
proposals.reason: The idiomatic English fuses the heir-apparent office with Wang Xi's name, making 'Heir Apparent Wang Xi' look like one person.

proposals.before: His wife Lady Liu died early; one daughter was very young; his nephew Yuan Yan had just borne a son Tuan when his wife Lady Liu also died; Xingzong's elder sister was Yan's mother.
proposals.after: His wife Lady Liu died early; one daughter was very young; his nephew Yuan Yan had just had a son Tuan when Yan's wife Lady Liu also died; Xingzong's elder sister was Yan's mother.
proposals.reason: 'Borne' is wrong for a male parent, and the second Lady Liu is Yan's wife, not Xingzong's.

proposals.before: Earlier when Zun was at Linhai, commoner Yang Yuansun posted maid Cailan with fellow villager Huang Quan; they agreed she would bear a child and pay nursing wages.
proposals.after: Earlier when Zun was at Linhai, commoner Yang Yuansun pledged the maid Cailan to fellow villager Huang Quan; they agreed she would bear a child and that nursing wages would be paid.
proposals.reason: 貼與 is a pledge/pawn of the maid, not 'posted' her as if sending an official.

proposals.before: He once memorialized to appoint Langya Wang Yun as Attendant Within the Gates; the Emperor disliked his not taking part in joint administration and pushed the white dossier beneath the fragrant orange: "You truly do not understand affairs."
proposals.after: He once memorialized to appoint Langya Wang Yun as Attendant Within the Gates; the Emperor disliked his not taking part in joint administration and pushed the white dossier beneath the fragrant stool: "You truly do not understand affairs."
proposals.reason: 香橙 here is a wooden stool (橙/凳), not the fruit orange; the emperor pushed the dossier under a fragrant stool.

proposals.before: He once memorialized to appoint Langya Wang Yun as Attendant Within the Gates; the Emperor disliked his not taking part in joint administration and pushed the white dossier to the ground beneath the fragrant orange and said: "You truly do not understand affairs."
proposals.after: He once memorialized to appoint Langya Wang Yun as Attendant Within the Gates; the Emperor disliked his not taking part in joint administration and pushed the white dossier to the ground beneath the fragrant stool and said: "You truly do not understand affairs."
proposals.reason: Same 香橙 stool, not orange fruit.

proposals.before: He held the dossier straight out and left, ordered his carriage and departed, and still wished to memorialized in protest to resign.
proposals.after: He held the dossier straight out and left, ordered his carriage and departed, and still wished to memorialize in protest to resign.
proposals.reason: English verb is ungrammatical: memorialized should be infinitive memorialize.

proposals.before: He thereupon held the dossier straight out and left, immediately ordered his carriage and departed, and still wished to memorialized in protest to resign.
proposals.after: He thereupon held the dossier straight out and left, immediately ordered his carriage and departed, and still wished to memorialize in protest to resign.
proposals.reason: Same ungrammatical infinitive memorialized.

decisions.reason: 列傳第十九 is the chapter serial, not a reign year; 'Biographies 19' matches the Chinese.
The censor is 王准之 (Wang, not Xu). 輒殺人 means killing on his own authority, not specifically 'more than once'.

sourceWitness.excerpt: 世子左衛率謝靈運輒殺人，御史中丞王准之坐不糾免官

decisions.reason: The following 但 clause shows this 不可 is concessive ('nothing objectionable / not impermissible'), not a refusal; 'It cannot be done' would reverse the speaker's judgment.
令孫 is one given name and should be romanized Lingsun, not two English words.
袁湣孫 is the three-character name Yuan Minsun; dropping 孫 as Yuan Min is a naming error.
The literal field likewise shortens 袁湣孫 to Yuan Min; restoring Yuan Minsun is required.
子頊 is Zixu; Ziye would be a different given name (子業).
The literal field repeats Ziye for 子頊; Zixu is the correct romanization.
侍中袁湣孫 is Yuan Minsun; the English must retain 孫.
衛尉 is the palace-guard chamberlain, not 宗正 (Imperial Clan).

decisions.after: He was transferred to Vice Director of the Secretariat and soon also concurrently headed the Court of the Palace Guards (Weiwei).
decisions.reason: 衛尉 is not the Imperial Clan, but 'headed the Guard Commandant' is ungrammatical; 尋領 means he concurrently headed that office.

sourceWitness.excerpt: 遷尚書右僕射，尋領衛尉

decisions.reason: 南掖門 is the South Lateral Gate; 'Yeb' is not a valid reading of 掖.
始昌縣伯 and 樂安縣伯 are county earldoms (伯), not marquisates (侯).

sourceWitness.excerpt: 封興宗始昌縣伯，固讓，不許，改封樂安縣伯

decisions.reason: 手詔 is a handwritten edict, not an edition.
珍孫子景先 is Jingxian, son of Zhensun; 子 here is kinship 'son', not part of a 'grandson' reading.
晉安王子勳 is Prince Zixun; Ziluan is a different prince's name.
太子左率 modifies 王錫, not an heir apparent named Wang Xi; reordering removes a real misparse.
始生子 cannot take 'borne' of the male nephew, and the second 妻劉氏 is Yan's wife.

sourceWitness.excerpt: 外甥袁覬始生子彖，而妻劉氏亦亡

decisions.reason: 貼與 is a pledge or pawn of the maid to Huang Quan, not 'posting' her.

sourceWitness.excerpt: 以婢采蘭貼與同里黃權

decisions.reason: 香橙 is a fragrant stool (橙 for 凳), not the fruit orange.
The literal field likewise misreads 香橙 as orange fruit rather than a stool.
'wished to memorialized' is ungrammatical; the infinitive memorialize is required.
The literal field has the same ungrammatical 'to memorialized'.

claimRevisions.reason: The English surname Xu was invented; 王准之 is Wang Zhunzhi.

killed men on his own authority

claimRevisions.reason: 輒殺人 supports unauthorized killing, not a count of 'repeatedly'.
令孫 is a single given name; the extracted English split it into two words.
The English dropped 孫 from 袁湣孫; the personal name is Yuan Minsun.
子頊 is Zixu, not Ziye.
侍中袁湣孫 must be Yuan Minsun in English, not Yuan Min.
子勳 is Zixun; Ziluan is a different imperial given name.
